facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Education, mentorship, in-kind services and investor access; no standardized direct program investment confirmed on current 2027 application page.
facts_raw.Capital Disclosure Status: Verified — No Standard Program Capital Publicly Disclosed
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Student or recent grad eligibility per NEXT36; program built around Canadian founder ecosystem.
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Commit full-time May–Aug 2027; be present in Toronto for required summer sessions; participate in all mandatory program activities.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Jan–Apr 2027 virtual; May–Aug 2027 in-person Toronto, full-time intensive.
facts_raw.International Founder: 可能接受国际 founder；需确认签证/现场要求
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: Education experience, short-answer questions, max-60-second video response.
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Student / recent-grad founders 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已经是成熟公司、团队与商业模型固定且只想拿融资
